title: Home Construction Services in Chennai: Design to Handover

seo.metaTitle: Turnkey Home Construction Services in Chennai | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: Turnkey house construction in Chennai: soil test, design, approvals, then building with daily site reports and stage-linked payments. Request a site visit.

excerpt: Our turnkey home construction service covers the soil test, design and drawings, approvals, construction with daily site updates and a defects walkthrough at handover, with materials named in every quote.
faqTitle: Our home construction service: common questions

faqs.question: What are your home construction packages?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. Every quote names the brand and grade behind each line.

faqs.question: What updates will I get during construction?
faqs.answer: A daily report from site: photographs, what was done, what is next and what is holding things up. You should not have to drive across the city to find out whether the slab was poured.

faqs.question: What does your quote include, and what does it leave out?
faqs.answer: Included: structural work, masonry, plastering, flooring, doors and windows, electrical, plumbing and painting, with the material specification named against each line. Not included unless stated: compound wall, sump, borewell, landscaping, interiors, soil test and approval or statutory fees.

faqs.question: How are payments scheduled?
faqs.answer: Against completed stages, never against dates. You pay for work you can see, after you have seen it.

faqs.question: Why do you book the soil test on day one?
faqs.answer: Because it decides the foundation, and the report takes four to six weeks. Running it alongside design keeps it from holding up the rest of the project.
